init_MyModel: create a MyModel instance with a random seed integer for model initialization
save_MyModel: save a MyModel checkpoint to a given directory path with a timestamped .pt file
review_MyModel: review the MyModel class and its save method for checkpoint directory creation logic
refactor_MyModel_save: refactor the MyModel save method to support additional checkpoint metadata or formats
